For tomorrow, August 6th, in Santa Clara — you're looking at a high around **82°F (28°C)** and a low of about **58°F (14°C)**. Expect sunny skies with a westerly breeze picking up in the afternoon, 5–9 mph. Pretty typical early-August Bay Area weather — warm but comfortable.
